notes.title: Your Support Means Everything!
notes.content: [p]Hello, dear Italian Brainrot players! 👋[/p][p]From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for your reviews — funny, sincere, and so motivating! Every comment, every joke, and every discussion in the community gives us the energy to keep working and make the game even better.[/p][p]You don't just play — you create the very atmosphere that makes Italian Brainrot truly special. Thanks for the memes, streams, incredible moments, and for sticking with us on this crazy adventure![/p][p]We're hard at work — stay tuned for updates! 💥[/p][p][i]— With love, the Italian Brainrot team.[/i][/p]
